caption: The drawing features a central object that appears to be a goblet or chalice with a bulbous, translucent upper vessel, colored in light gray with subtle shading, and an ornate, elongated stem and base in shades of gold and yellow, with detailed floral or decorative patterns. The vessel has a wide, flaring rim and a narrower neck, with a band of decorative motifs encircling the neck and another pattern encircling the widest part of the vessel. The stem transitions from the vessel with a gold connector and descends into a tall, intricate, textured structure that flares outward at the foot. Surrounding the central object are smaller, technical schematic drawings in pencil: at the lower left is a simple outline profile of the vessel labeled with measurements; to its right are three additional schematic details showing the upper vessel rim motif, a partial side view of a component, and another geometric decorative detail; at the lower right is a triangular motif also marked with measurements. The overall composition is rendered on an off-white or beige paper background with all schematic lines and text in gray pencil.
title: Metal Base Lamp
